r0.t: Pressure on the sternum, with busy, anxious manner, as if anticipating a great pleasure

r1.t: Gives him no rest in the house, has to go into the open air and be active

r2.t: Anxiety under the sternum, has to breathe deeply

r3.t: Afterwards sting¬ ing pain in the sternum

r4.t: AA 7 arm about breast and anxious

r5.t: Several successive short stitches in sternum, has to scream

r6.t: Gnawing and heat in the walls of the chest, with itching and anxiety

r7.t: Cannot sleep on account of restlessness, with pain in the chest, cannot touch it

r8.t: Large painful blisters on the left side of the chest and back, which break with fever heat, sweat and anxiety

r9.t: Miliary itching eruption, with derangement of mind
